name: First Time? (James Franco)
meaning: James Franco stands at the gallows with a noose around his neck, smiling wryly and asking "First time?". For a grizzled veteran utterly unfazed by a disaster that is shocking a newcomer, because he has lived it many times.
when_to_use: Top caption is the newcomer's horrified discovery; bottom is Franco's deadpan "First time?". Insider camaraderie over shared recurring pain.
